user.title: Wallet by BudgetBakers
user.description: Paste the Bearer token from the Wallet web app (Premium required). It is stored securely and never logged.

data_description.token: Web app → Settings → API. The same token maps to one Wallet account.

reauth_confirm.title: Re-authenticate Wallet
reauth_confirm.description: The stored token was rejected. Paste a fresh Bearer token to reconnect.

error.invalid_auth: The token was rejected. Check that it is current and copied in full.
error.cannot_connect: Could not reach the Wallet API. Check your connection and try again.
error.rate_limited: The Wallet API rate limit is exhausted. Wait a while and try again.

abort.already_configured: This Wallet token is already set up.

init.title: Wallet options
init.description: Choose which accounts and budgets to expose and the reporting period. Fewer items means fewer API requests.

data.custom_start: Custom range start (only for Custom range)
data.custom_end: Custom range end (only for Custom range)

add_record.name: Add record
add_record.description: Create an expense or income on a cash/manual account. The amount sign selects the type (negative = expense, positive = income); the currency is inherited from the account. Bank-synced accounts are read-only and rejected.

account_id.name: Account
account_id.description: ID of a cash/manual account to add the record to.

amount.name: Amount (signed)
amount.description: Non-zero amount. Negative for an expense, positive for an income.

category_id.name: Category
category_id.description: Optional category ID for the record.

record_date.name: Date
record_date.description: Optional record date and time (defaults to now). Must not be more than 24 hours in the future.

label_ids.name: Labels
label_ids.description: Optional list of label IDs to attach.

update_record.name: Update record
update_record.description: Patch an existing record. Only the fields you provide are changed. The amount sign selects the type (negative = expense, positive = income).

record_id.name: Record
record_id.description: ID of the record to update.

amount.name: Amount (signed)
amount.description: New non-zero amount. Negative = expense, positive = income.

label_ids.name: Labels
label_ids.description: Replace the record's labels with this list.

delete_record.name: Delete record
delete_record.description: Delete a record. By default it is blocked if other entities reference it; set Force to delete anyway.

record_id.name: Record
record_id.description: ID of the record to delete.

force.name: Force
force.description: Delete even if the record is referenced by other entities.

add_transfer.name: Add transfer
add_transfer.description: Move money between two of your accounts. The amount is the positive magnitude to move from the source to the target. Bank-synced accounts are read-only.

pairing_mode.name: Pairing
pairing_mode.description: New = create a linked mirror on the target; Unpaired = single transfer record.

manage_budget.name: Manage budget
manage_budget.description: Create, patch or delete a budget. For create, name/currency/type/limit are required; BUDGET_CUSTOM also needs start and end dates.

manage_category.name: Manage category
manage_category.description: Create a custom subcategory (needs name + parent), patch a category, or delete a custom category.

manage_account.name: Manage account
manage_account.description: Create or patch a cash/manual account. Account deletion is not supported in this version.

manage_label.name: Manage label
manage_label.description: Create or patch a label. Label deletion is not supported in this version.

delete_standing_order.name: Delete standing order
delete_standing_order.description: Delete a recurring standing order by id.

standing_order_id.name: Standing order
standing_order_id.description: ID of the standing order to delete.

delete_record_rule.name: Delete record rule
delete_record_rule.description: Delete a record auto-categorisation rule by id.

record_rule_id.name: Record rule
record_rule_id.description: ID of the record rule to delete.
